summary: Southern Copper Corp filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a registered public offering of $1.25 billion aggregate principal amount of 5.350% notes due 2036. The notes were issued under an existing shelf registration and underwritten by BofA Securities, Morgan Stanley, Barclays, and Santander. Net proceeds of approximately $1.241 billion will fund the Tia Maria project, capital expenditures, and general corporate purposes via its Peruvian branch. The filing is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
